subject: general
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark(?) in it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/720dd08f39826ef4181c93c62da25ca5011cfb5147b9af845afd78f4015a5757.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Addition of values of outer circle = value of inner circle

Figure 1: 6 + 5 + 4 + 3 = 18

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7563cbce05a89377bdd285a8ef1c2163c8177e21e0a02c6889b2df327b6f1498.png] 

Figure 2: 4 + 3 + 11 + 7 = 25

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4eb36f8adc3ba246b76b5e2e3081021d938b1e3e989ee50fcdf925e55316038.png] 

Figure 3: 12 + 5 + 13 + 10 = 40

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b84f424b42c2f09341ef20258346c97a7f1b9a130a9235676c11c1f12c6c4da6.png] 

Hence the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
